Title: Successfully retrieve all service items
Preconditions: At least one service item exists in the system
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/items.
Expected Result: Response status code is 200 and the response body contains a list of all service items with their details (id, name, description).

Title: Successfully retrieve a service item by ID
Preconditions: A service item with the specified ID exists in the system
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/items/{id} with the ID of an existing service item.
Expected Result: Response status code is 200 and the response body contains the service item details (id, name, description).

Title: Successfully add a new service item
Preconditions: User has admin privileges
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/items with the payload in testData.

Test Data: {"name": "Oil Change", "description": "Standard oil change service"}
Expected Result: Response status code is 200 and the response body contains the newly created service item details (id, name, description).

Title: Successfully update an existing service item
Preconditions: A service item with the specified ID exists in the system and user has admin privileges
Steps:
1. Send a PUT request to /api/items/{id} with the payload in testData and the ID of an existing service item.

Test Data: {"name": "Premium Oil Change", "description": "Premium oil change service with synthetic oil"}
Expected Result: Response status code is 200 and the response body contains the updated service item details (id, name, description).

Title: Successfully delete an existing service item
Preconditions: A service item with the specified ID exists in the system and user has admin privileges
Steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /api/items/{id} with the ID of an existing service item.
Expected Result: Response status code is 204 (No Content).

Title: Successfully process payment for a completed appointment with due amount
Preconditions: An appointment exists with 'serviceStatus' as 'COMPLETE' and 'dueAmount' greater than 0
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to the payment endpoint (assumed /api/payments) with the appointment ID in testData.

Test Data: {"appointmentId": 123}
Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response body contains the payment details (appointmentId, paymentIntentId, amount) and the appointment's 'paymentStatus' is updated to 'PAID' with 'dueAmount' set to 0.

Title: Fail to process payment for an incomplete appointment
Preconditions: An appointment exists with 'serviceStatus' not equal to 'COMPLETE' and 'dueAmount' greater than 0
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to the payment endpoint (assumed /api/payments) with the appointment ID in testData.

Test Data: {"appointmentId": 123}
Expected Result: Response status code is 400 or 500. The response body contains an error message: 'Service not completed yet'.

Title: Successfully mark cash payment as received for a completed appointment
Preconditions: An appointment exists with 'serviceStatus' as 'COMPLETE' and 'dueAmount' greater than 0
Steps: 1. Send a PUT request to the cash payment endpoint (assumed /api/appointments/{id}/cash-payment) with the appointment ID.
Expected Result: Response status code is 200. The response body contains the updated appointment details with 'cashReceived' set to the 'dueAmount' value, 'dueAmount' set to 0, and 'paymentStatus' updated to 'PAID'.

Title: Attempt to delete a non-existent service item
Preconditions: User is authenticated with ROLE_ADMIN privileges
Steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /api/items/99999 (a non-existent ID).
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 404 Not Found status code with no response body.

Title: Unauthorized user attempts to delete a service item
Preconditions: User is authenticated without ROLE_ADMIN privileges
Steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /api/items/1 (an existing ID).
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 403 Forbidden status code with an error message indicating that the user does not have permission to delete the item.

Title: Attempt to update a service item with a non-existent ID
Preconditions: User is authenticated with valid privileges
Steps:
1. Send a PUT request to /api/items/99999 (a non-existent ID) with a valid Item payload in testData.

Test Data: {"name": "Oil Change", "description": "Standard oil change service"}
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 404 Not Found status code with an error message indicating that the service item was not found.

Title: Attempt to create a service item with missing required fields
Preconditions: User is authenticated with valid privileges
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/items with the payload in testData (missing 'name' field).

Test Data: {"description": "Standard oil change service"}
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the 'name' field is required.

Title: Attempt to retrieve a service item by malformed ID
Preconditions: User is authenticated with valid privileges
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/items/abc (a non-numeric ID).
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the ID must be a valid number.

Title: Attempt to process payment for an appointment with incomplete service status
Preconditions: User is authenticated with valid privileges. An appointment exists with ID 1, status 'PENDING', and dueAmount > 0.
Steps: 1. Send a POST request to the payment endpoint (implied by AppointmentPaymentService) for appointment ID 1.
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the service is not completed yet.

Title: Attempt to process payment for an appointment with null dueAmount
Preconditions: User is authenticated with valid privileges. An appointment exists with ID 2, status 'COMPLETE', and dueAmount = null.
Steps: 1. Send a POST request to the payment endpoint for appointment ID 2.
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the payment cannot be processed due to invalid due amount.

Title: Attempt to process payment for a canceled appointment
Preconditions: User is authenticated with valid privileges. An appointment exists with ID 3, status 'CANCELED', and dueAmount > 0.
Steps: 1. Send a POST request to the payment endpoint for appointment ID 3.
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that payment cannot be done for a canceled appointment.

Title: Attempt to process payment for an already paid appointment
Preconditions: User is authenticated with valid privileges. An appointment exists with ID 4, status 'COMPLETE', paymentStatus 'PAID', and dueAmount = 0.
Steps: 1. Send a POST request to the payment endpoint for appointment ID 4.
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the payment has already been done.

Title: Attempt to search for a service item with missing name parameter
Preconditions: User is authenticated with valid privileges
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/items/search without the 'name' query parameter.
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the 'name' parameter is required.

Title: Attempt to update a service item with mismatched ID in path and payload
Preconditions: User is authenticated with valid privileges. A service item exists with ID 1.
Steps:
1. Send a PUT request to /api/items/2 (path ID 2) with a payload containing ID 1 in testData.

Test Data: {"id": 1, "name": "Oil Change", "description": "Standard oil change service"}
Expected Result: The system should return an HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with an error message indicating that the ID in the path and payload must match.

Test Data: {"name":"","description":"Test item"}

Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/items with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response status code and body.

Test Data: {"name":"a".repeat(255),"description":"Test item"}

Title: Add a new item with name exceeding maximum allowed length
Preconditions: User has the necessary permissions to add items
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/items with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response status code and body.

Test Data: {"name":"a".repeat(256),"description":"Test item"}
Expected Result: HTTP status code 400 with an error message indicating that the item name exceeds the maximum length

Title: Update an existing item with empty name
Preconditions: User has the necessary permissions to update items and an existing item
Steps:
1. Send a PUT request to /api/items/{id} with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response status code and body.

Test Data: {"name":"","description":"Updated test item"}

Steps:

Test Data: {"appointmentId":1,"amount":0}

Title: Create payment for an appointment with very large total amount
Preconditions: User has the necessary permissions to create payments and an existing appointment
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to the payment endpoint with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response status code and body.

Test Data: {"appointmentId":1,"amount":1000000}
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 with the payment details

Title: Create payment for a non-existent appointment
Preconditions: User has the necessary permissions to create payments
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to the payment endpoint with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response status code and body.

Test Data: {"appointmentId":99999,"amount":100}
Expected Result: HTTP status code 404 with an error message indicating that the appointment was not found

Title: Verify unauthorized user cannot delete an item
Preconditions: An item with ID 1 exists in the system. User is not authenticated as an ADMIN.
Steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /api/items/1 without ADMIN role credentials.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 403 Forbidden or 401 Unauthorized, and the item is not deleted.

Title: Verify deletion of non-existent item returns appropriate status
Preconditions: No item with ID 999 exists in the system. User is authenticated as an ADMIN.
Steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /api/items/999 with ADMIN role credentials.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 404 Not Found.

Title: Verify successful deletion of an item returns appropriate status
Preconditions: An item with ID 1 exists in the system. User is authenticated as an ADMIN.
Steps: 1. Send a DELETE request to /api/items/1 with ADMIN role credentials.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 204 No Content, and the item is no longer retrievable.

Title: Verify payment cannot be processed for an incomplete appointment
Preconditions: An appointment with ID 1 exists in the system with serviceStatus 'PENDING' and dueAmount 100. User is authenticated.
Steps: 1. Send a POST request to the payment endpoint for appointment ID 1 (assumed to be /api/payments/appointments/1).
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 Bad Request and an error message 'Service not completed yet'.

Title: Verify payment status is set to PAID after cash payment for completed appointment
Preconditions: An appointment with ID 1 exists in the system with serviceStatus 'COMPLETE' and dueAmount 100. User is authenticated.
Steps: 1. Send a POST request to update the appointment cash payment status (assumed to be /api/appointments/1/cash-payment).
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 200 OK, and the appointment's paymentStatus is 'PAID' and dueAmount is 0 in the response body.

Title: Verify item search handles special characters in name parameter
Preconditions: User is authenticated. Items exist in the system.
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/items/search?name=<script>alert(1)</script>.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 Bad Request or 200 OK with an empty result, but does not execute the script or return a 500 error.

Title: Verify item search handles SQL injection in name parameter
Preconditions: User is authenticated. Items exist in the system.
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/items/search?name=' OR '1'='1.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 400 Bad Request or 200 OK with an empty result, but does not return all items or a 500 error.

Title: Verify user cannot access item details for an item they do not own (if applicable)
Section: Item Management - Insecure Direct Object Reference
Preconditions: Items with IDs 1 and 2 exist in the system. User A owns item 1, User B is authenticated but does not own item 1.
Steps: 1. As User B, send a GET request to /api/items/1.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found, and does not return item 1's details.
